description: BrandyFly offline map engine benchmark fixture manifest — Alpine Dachstein/Krippenstein area

fixtures.description: Vector tiles — OpenMapTiles schema, zoom 0-14. Source: Natural Earth (public domain) + OSM extract (ODbL). NOT bundled in this repo; must be generated by operator using the procedure in BENCHMARK_PROCEDURE.md before device runs.
fixtures.redistributionTerms: Permitted under ODbL 1.0 with attribution. No bulk download in violation of OSM tile usage policy.

fixtures.description: Raster terrain-RGB DEM tiles — Copernicus GLO-30, zoom 0-12, 30m resolution. NOT bundled in this repo; must be generated by operator before device runs.
fixtures.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus DEM data © ESA/Copernicus (2021) distributed under CC BY 4.0.

fixtures.description: Deterministic 10-minute camera path with 40 waypoints over the Dachstein/Krippenstein area.
fixtures.source: Synthetically generated from known Alpine topography coordinates. Not derived from any copyrightable work.

fixtures.description: Static overlay geometry: airspace polygons, flight track, thermal markers, pilot position. All synthetic.
fixtures.source: Synthetic. Airspace boundaries are approximate reference shapes for visual testing, not authoritative aeronautical data.

mandatoryGates.offlinePass: All tile requests must be served from local PMTiles — no network requests permitted during a valid run.
mandatoryGates.fpsGateDescription: p95 frame time must be ≤ 16.7 ms (≥ 60 FPS) on both Android and iOS reference devices.
mandatoryGates.thermalInvalidation: A run where the device was outside the documented thermal state before start, or throttled during setup, must be excluded and repeated.
